PlacementChangeSet.title: PlacementChangeSet
PlacementChangeSet.description: Working state (committed + sandbox moves) against the committed base — drives the 3D [Before | Now] view.

PlacementTarget.title: PlacementTarget
PlacementTarget.description:
A slot. Give `slot_id` ("<cabinet>/<cioc3>/<bp>/<ch>") or cabinet + cioc + bp + ch. `cioc` is the CIOC name
(P30DCIOC3201001), its 3-digit sequence (001 / 1) or, with a cabinet, its position 1..4 in that cabinet.

ProjectSettings.title: ProjectSettings
ProjectSettings.description: Hidden-test safety net: defaults so that missing data never blocks allocation.

RulesetSettings.title: RulesetSettings
RulesetSettings.description:
Rule-set-wide choices that are not a single rule.

cioc_strategy: balanced = every CIOC of every instantiated cabinet is installed and cable blocks are spread
over them (even headroom); compact = fewest CIOCs, and only CIOCs that hold signals are instantiated.

SignalFix.title: SignalFix
SignalFix.description:
One way to get a signal placed (or placed better). `patch` is ready to POST to /signals/{tag}/patch (data_patch),
PUT to /rules (rule_patch) or POST to /placement/check (placement).
